title: MTVQA: Benchmarking Multilingual Text-Centric Visual Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the accuracy of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on text-centric Visual Question Answering (VQA) tasks across 9 diverse languages to measure performance disparities between high-resource, Latin-alphabet languages and lower-resource or non-Latin languages, alongside a failure case analysis that categorizes language-specific reasoning errors.
